payload.notes: Registered by the D6-SEC findings clerk from the D6-SEC review round 1 (lens ssot), re-checked at head d460f7917 before registration; non-blocking at merge. Close condition: ARIA-MEDIUM-966 is closed by a commit whose Closes: trailer names it and whose body says that d460f7917 removed the lift's own argv and parse (the data-only comparison owns the lift's changed-path read; change_paths keeps the revision-to-revision reads), citing the ARIA-HIGH-964 tests in aria-kernel/tests/test_seat_pin_proof.py (SeatTreeIsReadAsDataTests) that fail if git runs over the seat's tree; or its row is rewritten to that scope with the contradicting condition removed.
